A custom title bar.

**Download `iconger.exe` below**, or open Iconger: it will offer the update itself.

## New
- **Iconger draws its own title bar.** The plain Windows bar is gone: the logo sits at the top of the sidebar, and minimize, maximize and close are drawn to match the app (close turns red when you point at it).
- Everything a normal window does still works: drag it by the top strip, double-click to maximize, right-click for the window menu, resize from any edge, snap it to screen edges. On Windows 11, pointing at the maximize button shows the Snap Layouts picker as usual.
- On Windows 11 the thin window border matches the app's colours.

Your backups and settings carry over.
